image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on yellow flowers. The butterfly's wings are spread open, displaying the dorsal side which is dark brown with distinct cream-ringed black eyespots (ocelli). A second partial butterfly is visible on the right edge. The background consists of soft-focus green foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wings are dark brown. Multiple eyespots with pale rings are clearly visible on both forewings and hindwings, arranged in a row near the margins.

The body appears slender and has a visible fuzzy/hairy texture consistent with lepidoptera.
